functionalReqs: Search books by title, author, subject

Borrow and return copies; max 5 per member, 15-day loan
Reserve a book; notify when available
hints: Separate the abstract Book (title, author) from BookItem (a physical copy with barcode).

Library, Book, BookItem, Member, Librarian, Loan, Reservation, Fine; SearchService with indexes; NotificationService (Observer) for reservations; FinePolicy strategy.

problemStatement: Design a **library management system**: members search the catalogue, borrow and return book copies, reserve books that are out, and pay fines for late returns.
title: Design a Library Management System
